CANONICAL_NAME.value: cJSON 1.7.18 -- an ultralightweight JSON parser in ANSI C (Dave Gamble et al.)

value.lineage: Single-file recursive-descent JSON parser (2009-) used in embedded and IoT code; the defensive half of the fuzzing PAIR with radamsa-0.6: fed mutated inputs under AddressSanitizer, it must reject or parse, never crash. cJSON's own history includes CVEs found by exactly this pressure (e.g. CVE-2019-11834), which is why the pair is instructive.

value.built_to: turn untrusted text into a tree or refuse it, on small machines
value.pressure: malformed, truncated, deeply nested and hostile input; tiny memory budgets
value.success_means: every input either parses to a well-formed tree or returns NULL; no memory error

value.failure_condition: a crafted input reads or writes out of bounds (the CVE history)
